411005.name: Resetting: Decreased Cooldown
411005.description: Decreases the cooldown of [Resetting] by 30 seconds.

411006.name: Forecast: Increased Nullification
411006.description: Increases the chance to nullify an enemy's attack while activating [Forecast] by 1% per attribute level.

411007.name: Arcane Energy: Duration
411007.description: Increases the duration of [Arcane Energy] by 1 minute per attribute level.

411008.name: Death Sentence: Slow
411008.description: Decreases the movement speed of an enemy affected by [Death Sentence] by 15% per attribute level.

412002.name: Incineration: Enhance
412002.description: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Incineration] by 1% per attribute level.

412003.name: Bloodletting: Hemostasis
412003.description: Increases the cycle time of the HP cost by 0.02 seconds per attribute level while [Bloodletting] is in effect.

412004.name: Bloodletting: Substitute SP
412004.description: Each tick has a 10% chance per attribute level to reduce SP instead of HP while [Bloodletting] is in effect.

412005.name: Fumigate: Prevention
412005.description: Increases the chance that [Fumigate] blocks Lv3 or weaker status ailments for 10 seconds by 5% per attribute level.

412006.name: Fumigate: Purification
412006.description: The range of [Fumigate] becomes a purification area for 10 seconds. Increases the ally's poison resistance by 10% per attribute level.

412007.name: Bird Beak Mask: Immunity
412007.description: Increases the chance to block Lv3 status ailments by 5% per attribute level, but also increases the SP cost whilst wearing the [Bird Beak Mask].

412008.name: Bird Beak Mask: Poison Resistance
412008.description: Increases Poison property resistance by 5 per attribute level whilst wearing the [Bird Beak Mask].

413001.name: Revenged Sevenfold: Duration
413001.description: Increases the duration of [Revenged Sevenfold]'s effect by 1 second per attribute level.

413002.name: Revenged Sevenfold: Curse
413002.description: Inflicts [Curse] at a 10% chance for 4 seconds on an enemy when damage is dealt with [Revenged Sevenfold].

413006.name: Ein Sof: Maintain Time
413006.description: Increases the duration of [Ein Sof] tiles by 1 second per attribute level.

413008.name: Merkabah: Enhance
413008.description: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Merkabah] by 1% per attribute level.

413009.name: Merkabah: Petrification
413009.description: Inflicts [Petrification] for 3 seconds on enemies affected by [Curse] when attacking with [Merkabah].

413010.name: Ein Sof: SP Recovery
413010.description: Exchanges half the maximum HP recovery of [Ein Sof] for SP recovery instead.

414001.name: Last Rites: Promoting Spirits
414001.description: Increases the lower limit HP of [Last Rites] by 2% per attribute level.

414002.name: Deploy Cappella: Duration
414002.description: Increases the duration of the deployed capella of [Deploy Cappella] by 3 seconds.

414003.name: Magnus Exorcismus: Enhance
414003.description: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Magnus Exorcismus] by 1% per attribute level.

414005.name: Chaplain: SP Recovery
414005.description: Increases the character's SP recovery rate by 1 per attribute level.

414006.name: Chaplain: Motivation
414006.description: Increases the block penetration on the attack that hits an enemy by 15% per attribute level while [Last Rites] and [Revive] are in effect.
